name: grok-bot-bridge
description: Send a task to your Grok Bot once, then collect the BRIDGE_RESULT reply.

bridge_url.title: Webhook URL
bridge_url.description: HTTPS webhook URL from the Grok Bot inbox routine. In the app: Bot details, Routines, right-click the inbox row, Webhook.

bridge_key.title: Webhook key
bridge_key.description: Webhook key from the same Grok Bot inbox routine. Claude Code stores it in secure storage.
